    Class EvaluateCommand

    Built-in evaluate (aliases: eval, ev, js, ts, py) message command that evaluates JavaScript/TypeScript code with Discord context variables (message, client, guild, channel, Discord, _) in scope, or delegates to shell, git, and source sub-modes.
